steps.content: Thud!
The Corruptors hysterically slam their bodies against the battered wooden door. You are nestled inside the room behind the door with a team of guards and some frightened civilians.
Ten minutes ago, you heard calls for help on your way back from a field mission. To protect the civilians in need, you were caught up in a small-scale contamination outbreak.

The Corruptor siege grows more and more frenzied. You have nowhere left to retreat. Your last line of defense wavers as the wooden door is battered to pieces, while aid from the Sinners is still far away.
Everyone, take cover and distract the Corruptors! Protect the Chief and the civilians to safety first!

options: Is it help from the MBCC?

choices.text: Is it help from the MBCC?

steps.content: It's not the MBCC.
Gunshots ring out from outside the door, and an unfamiliar female voice begins to speak through the comms.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, I'm Captain Claire of the 6th Squadron. As the closest FAC squadron to you, we are here to keep you safe!

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Leave the fighting to us. Adjutant Nightingale has already dispatched medical support from the MBCC, so please don't worry.
The message from the comms is intertwined with the roars of the monsters beyond the door. It seems that the situation is still dismal.

options: Is there anything we can do?

choices.text: Is there anything we can do?

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: ...You've already used up a lot of gunpowder and stamina to protect the civilians. What you need to do now is trust us.
A sense of reassuring smile can be heard from the comms. The civilians behind the door let out sighs of relief.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Nash, keep your distance, beware of Mania contamination!

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Direct all your firepower at seven o'clock—
The battle situation outside is a haze. You can only guess what's going on through Captain Claire's commands.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Katya, watch out—ahh!

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: Captain!
Screeching noises erupt from the comms as the equipment on the other side is impacted in battle.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: It's okay, just a few scratches... Everyone, deploy your defense barriers at eight o'clock! Don't let the monsters get close!
The battle rages on, and no one behind the door dares to relax. Everyone leans firmly against the wooden door, observing the battle situation through the comms with bated breaths.
The gunshots finally subside, and the Corruptors let out their final howls.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Phew... Chief, the crisis is over. You are safe now.
The guards carefully push open the door and peek out. Corruptor remains are strewn everywhere amidst the smoldering gunsmoke.
A female soldier in a bloodstained uniform stands nearby. She leads her team to salute you from a distance.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Chief, all eight members of the FAC's 6th Squadron are here. There are no casualties.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: No problem. It is the 6th Squadron's mission to fight. It is our duty.
She glances at the wounded civilians and guards.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: The MBCC's medical reinforcements should be arriving soon. Chief, all the follow-up work is now in your hands.
Don't worry. Guards, listen up.
Check to see if anyone is injured, and if they are, have them wait here for the medical team. As for everyone else, escort the civilians back home...

steps.speaker: 6th Squadron
steps.content: Captain!!
You sense something ominous when you hear the shout. Turning around, you see that Claire has collapsed to the ground.
The seemingly innocuous scratch on her jaw begins to emit eerie wisps of black smoke.

steps.speaker: Panicking squadron member
steps.content: Look, it's... a Mania Crystal! The Captain has been infected?!

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: The Captain was trying to protect me... Chief, what do we do?!
The joy of triumph suddenly vanishes. The squadron members all look at you in anticipation. They have no commanding officer now and need your orders.
Don't panic. Guards, carry on with your tasks. 6th Squadron...
You don't show any panic, but you are all too familiar with Mania Crystals. Anybody who comes into contact with them will mutate into a Corruptor very soon.
Don't worry. She got injured while trying to help the MBCC, so the MBCC will definitely save her.
Breathing as calmly as possible, you reach out to Claire. The medical team has not arrived yet. Perhaps you have to give it a go... and try to contain her Mania with your shackles.
Do you want to die with her here?
A familiar voice rings out from behind.
A robotic arm pushes through the crowd, and a reassuring white-robed figure comes to your side.
Iron?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Calm enough. Good job.
She raises her brows and nods. Eschewing any further pleasantries, she jumps into working mode and begins checking the patient's wound right away.
A Mania Crystal scratched her right lower jaw during the battle.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Time?
Around fifteen minutes ago.
While cleaning up the infection, Iron frowns as she measures with fingers the distance between Claire's wound and her brain.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The nerves are most active during high-intensity combat. Fifteen minutes... I'm afraid...
She kneels beside the patient and picks up the name tag on Claire's uniform.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: FAC...?
You are the only one who notices Iron's wariness towards the three letters.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...Captain Claire of the FAC's 6th Squadron, can you hear me? Open your eyes!
Claire frowns in pain.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Claire, can you hear me?
As Iron speaks, she puts her hand on top of Claire's head and begins to probe the contamination levels in her body with her neuroelectric powers.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: I'm... sorry...
After the third call, Claire forces open her eyelids with her lips trembling. Her right eye has already turned dark purple from being too close to the wound.
All the squadron members gasp at the Mania spreading so fast.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Try to make fists with both hands. Can you do it?
Claire's left hand clenches successfully, but her right hand stays still.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: There is still consciousness, but the neural connections have been severely corrupted, and the contamination has spread to the brain. Simply cleaning the wound won't help. Surgery is needed immediately.

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: Surgery? Now? Here?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: All unnecessary personnel, get lost! ${PlayerName}, stay to help.
The squadron members wince at you, obviously not comfortable with handing over their captain to a stranger.
Iron doesn't bother to assuage them. She has already started fishing out tools from her medical kit.
She's an excellent doctor. Trust her and step back.
The squadron members step back grudgingly. At the same time, after some simple sterilization, Iron quickly locates the area of incision on the right side of the skull.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Chief, give me the hook... the third tool from the left.
As Iron talks, she injects anesthesia into Claire, while scalpels and pincers pop out from her mechanical arm.
You recognize the shape of the robotic arm at this moment. Ted's benumbed face flashes in your mind. Tool in hand, your arm pauses in mid-air.

options: You're performing a nerve modification surgery?

choices.text: You're performing a nerve modification surgery?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You ask them to trust me, but you don't seem to trust me yourself?
Is this really the only option?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: What other choice do we have? Use your shackles on her and then perish together after losing control?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...You have twenty seconds to decide. The anesthesia will come into effect soon. This is a race against the spread of Mania!

options: You have no right to decide her future

choices.text: You have no right to decide her future

steps.content: Seeing Iron's conviction, you also stop hesitating. You kneel down to whisper into Claire's ear.
Listen, Claire. This operation can save your life, but you will lose all your emotions, desires, and memories. You will never be a soldier again.
Are you still willing to have the surgery under these conditions?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You have no right to let her die here! Mania won't wait for a consent form to be signed.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: If we suppress her Mania first, the doctors in Eastside may be able to help her recover later. But if she dies here now, it would really be over.
You can't argue with that. But as a soldier, is Claire really willing to lose her emotions, desires, and memories to live...? The twenty-second time limit ticks by bit by bit.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Live...
On the verge of death, Claire struggles to look towards her squadron members.

steps.speaker: Claire
steps.content: Save me... no matter what... they're... waiting for me...
Iron's silver mechanical arm is already in place when Claire spoke, as if expecting this answer from the beginning. Her other hand is outstretched to take the tool.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I know more about one's desire to survive than you... The third one from the left on the ground, please. Open up here. Hurry.
The surgery officially begins.
Having retreated to a distance, the 6th Squadron members cannot hear your conversation, nor witness Iron's breathtaking surgical skills. They can only wait anxiously.

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: Nash, did you see that electric current...

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: She's a Sinner... But in this situation, guess there's nothing else we can do.

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: Everyone from the squadron who touched that kind of crystal in the past, they all...

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: But Sinners are the source of the Mania crisis themselves!
Struggling, reluctant, and helpless... Every member of the squadron falls into silence.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: Do you remember what the Captain always likes to say?

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: It is the 6th Squadron's duty to fight.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: If that Sinner does anything that desecrates a soldier's dignity, I won't spare her!
Though comatose, Claire's vital signs are stable, and with the help of Iron's neuroelectric power, she feels no pain. The air reeks of burnt flesh and blood.
The operation is progressing smoothly. The murmurs in the distance do not affect Iron in the slightest.
One may find it hard to believe that the M-value of this calm doctor already approached the critical threshold many years ago.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Yes, I can hear them... you can release the hook now.
Is it because you're a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Mhmm... Needle and thread, please.
Should I explain on your behalf?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Explain what? It's true that I'm a Sinner, and the aftereffects of the surgery are indeed very severe.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: But it's also true that I'm the only one who can save her life.
Iron's tone is unusually calm. You notice that her actions have slowed down.
Are you encountering some difficulties in the surgery?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I'm just stitching. I don't want to leave any ugly scars on her, so I'm taking a bit more time.
Iron cuts free the last thread of stitching and puts down the surgical tool in her hands.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Did you get a good look at today's surgery?
Iron's speed was breathtaking. You only recall that she cut out some dark purple jelly-like tissue from a blurry mass of flesh, her tools traversing between blood vessel-like filaments.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...It's fine. I've already completed my purpose by letting you watch once.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The surgery is over. You can call them to come over.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: What did you say?!
The squadron member grabs her angrily by the collar, but Iron doesn't dodge. She just stares numbly at the all-too-familiar commotion, and repeats herself once more.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: The Mania lesions have been removed. All her emotions, desires, and memories have been lost.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: To suppress Mania, any violent impulses must be rooted out.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: Do you realize that she won't be able to go to the battlefield like this?! This is worse to her than killing her!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: This was her choice. It's a necessary sacrifice to survive.

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: No... it's impossible! I refuse to believe that the captain would accept such an operation!

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: The captain always told our teammates who got contaminated to have no regrets. The FAC lives for Mania and dies for Mania. Death by contamination is an honor!

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: She has always been a captain who shoulders everyone's willpower as she fights. If she knows she has to eke out a miserable, contaminated living, she'd never forgive herself...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Shut up! The life of a cripple is no different from that of a hero.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: Who are you calling a cripple?

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: This is all your fault! You prolonged the captain's pain with your stupid surgery and desecrated the dignity of a soldier!!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Is this how you FAC people treat their lifesavers?
Iron pushes aside the vexatious squadron members, fishes out a scalpel from her bag and flings it next to the comatose Claire.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: If you believe that dying on the battlefield is the proper dignity for a soldier, then go ahead.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: We... we certainly want her to live more than anyone else! But we also know Claire. She wouldn't have wanted...
Nash gawks at the scalpel on the ground, panting angrily, but someone else rush towards the blade without hesitation.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: Katya! What are you doing?!
The squadron member named Katya ignores her teammate's shout and lunges at Iron with the blade.
Stop!
Battle-weary Katya has long exhausted her fighting strength. You halt her easily, and she falls to her knees.
If it weren't for Iron, Claire would've mutated into a Corruptor by now, and we would've had to kill her. How can you be so ungrateful?

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: I... I can't do anything... I have to at least punish this vile woman who turned the captain into a walking corpse...

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: The 6th Squadron had eight members, now there are...
She has lost her wits and glares at Iron with burning hatred.
Claire knew what the surgery would cause. But she accepted it so she could return to you guys...

steps.speaker: Katya
steps.content: No! It can't be! I don't believe it! It must be the Sinner! This Sinner must have made the decision herself!
The rest of the squadron surrounds the unconscious captain, acquiescing to Katya's tantrum.
This is not how a life-saving doctor should be treated, but Iron's calm expression tells you that she faces such hostility on a daily basis.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: As I said, there is no need to explain. Don't waste your time.
She grabs you by the collar and turns to leave, ignoring the torrent of abuse from behind.
steps.female_content: She grabs you by the wrist and turns to leave, ignoring the torrent of abuse from behind.

steps.speaker: Nash
steps.content: Typical Sinner... Like I thought, you're all monsters... Coldhearted, ruthless monsters!

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Ha. Monsters you say...
Maybe you are hallucinating from battle fatigue, but you seem to see Iron smile upon hearing the word "monsters." It is a smile that is both helpless and reminiscent.
